panels.title: Requests /s by verdict
panels.description: Verified against the live VictoriaMetrics query API 2026-09-21. sum by (verdict) (rate(synthetic_proxy_requests_total[5m])) -> healthy 0/s, rate_limited 0.01/s (measured just after a rollout, so the counters were fresh). CAVEAT: each verdict series appears only once that verdict has occurred -- quota_exhausted and unhealthy require a quota or reachability event -- so an absent series means 'never happened', not zero.

panels.title: Upstream responses /s by code
panels.description: Verified 2026-09-21: sum by (code) (rate(synthetic_proxy_upstream_responses_total[5m])) -> 200 0/s, 429 0/s. CAVEAT: Synthetic's 429s reach here as 429 only for the transient parallel-limit flavour; failover-worthy 429s and 5xx are rewritten by the proxy to 503 before the gateway sees them, so code=503 is the signal that the proxy decided this leg was bad.

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: Verified 2026-09-21: histogram_quantile(...) -> p50 0.025s, p95 0.048s, p99 0.050s. Those values were dominated by local refusals (served in ~0ms, refusing without touching Synthetic) on a quiet instance; real streaming completions push into the 5-300s buckets.

panels.title: Refusals
panels.description: Verified 2026-09-21: 1% of traffic at that moment. This is the panel that makes a failover episode visible: it rises whenever the proxy refuses (quota_exhausted / rate_limited / unhealthy), which is when a caller is refused rather than served (the chains have had no fallback group since 2026-09-22).

panels.title: Keys tracked
panels.description: Verified 2026-09-21: 1. The deployment uses the single shared synthetic-key, so 1 is the expected value; a rising count means more keys are flowing through.

panels.title: Quota checks /s by result
panels.description: Verified 2026-09-21: result=ok present at 0/s. result=error appears only when the quota endpoint call itself fails, so an absent error series is the healthy state.

panels.title: Reachability probes /s by result
panels.description: NO DATA when verified 2026-09-21, and that is expected: synthetic_proxy_probes_total does not exist until the reachability probe actually runs, which happens only when the quota endpoint call fails. This panel is a diagnostic for exactly that failure mode -- it staying empty is normal, it appearing means the quota path is degraded.

panels.title: Requests handled (since start)
panels.description: Verified 2026-09-21: 16 requests handled since the process start (per-pod counter, resets on rollout).

Verified against the live VictoriaMetrics query API 2026-09-21 after this build rolled: 1 series present, reason="rate_limited" at 0/s -- i.e. the real proxy had already hit a genuine upstream rate-limit 429, which is the flavour this metric exists to expose. The other two reason series are absent until those flavours occur, so an absent line means 'never happened', not zero. All three were additionally verified end to end against a stub upstream driving one flavour per request key through an instance of this build: quota_exhausted 1, rate_limited 1, parallel_limit 1, with quota and generic rewritten to 503 (fail over) and parallel_limit passed through as 429 (no failover, no eviction). Use this panel to tell WHICH 429 problem is happening: parallel_limit is transient and self-heals; rate_limited is the one that only clears after a long no-poke window.
